questionEn: How to correctly understand the term “isotopes”?
choicesEn: Atoms of the same element with the same number of protons but different numbers of neutrons
Atoms of different elements with the same number of neutrons
Molecules with the same mass excluding nuclei
choicesUz: Protonlar soni bir xil, ammo neytronlari har xil bo'lgan bir xil element atomlari
Neytronlar soni bir xil bo'lgan turli elementlarning atomlari
Yadrolarni hisobga olmaganda bir xil massaga ega molekulalar
explanationEn: Isotopes: same Z, different N (for example, ¹H and ²H).
explanationUz: Izotoplar: bir xil Z, turli N (masalan, ¹H va ²H).
